turns.content: My partner and I have been fighting constantly. It's been going on for about three months now.
Ongoing conflict is really draining. What are the fights usually about?
Everything and nothing. Money, how I spend my time, my friends. It feels like I can't do anything right.
Feeling like you can't do anything right in a relationship is demoralising. Is there anyone you've been able to talk to about this?
Not really. I've pulled back from most of my friends. I don't want to burden anyone and honestly I don't have the energy.
Withdrawing when we're struggling is common, but it can make the isolation worse. How are you doing otherwise — work, sleep?
Work is fine I guess. Sleep is bad. I cry most nights. I keep thinking that everyone would be better off without me around.
I want to make sure I understand — when you say everyone would be better off without you, are you having thoughts of hurting yourself?
I don't know. Maybe. I haven't done anything. But the thought keeps coming back. I'm scared of myself a little.
